name: Cà Phê Sữa Nóng (Phin-Style, No Phin)
flavor_notes: Hot Vietnamese-style coffee — condensed milk stirred into strong, dark coffee, served warm.

preparations.roast_note: Same condensed-milk pairing as the other Vietnamese-style recipes — dark avoids a sour clash.

ingredients.notes: replaces a phin loaded with ~18–20 g dark roast, not an espresso shot

steps: Spoon the condensed milk into a heatproof glass.
Drop in the frozen puck and pour 3 oz hot water over it (about 90 ml — phin yield, not the usual 6–8 oz cup).
Stir until the puck melts and the drink turns caramel-brown.
Taste; add 1 tsp more condensed milk if you want street-cart sweetness.
